in_tamil.name: Dhanveer
in_tamil.meaning: இந்து பெயர் என்று பொருள் God's wealth, prosperity
in_tamil.long_meaning: Dhanveer ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। Dhanveer is a name derived from Sanskrit, meaning 'God's wealth' or 'prosperity'. This powerful name is deeply rooted in Hindu mythology, representing strength, courage, and abundance. It is believed that those named Dhanveer are blessed with prosperity, good fortune, and a strong sense of purpose.

vedic_reference.note: Dhanveer is a name derived from the Sanskrit word धनु (dhana), meaning wealth, and वीर (veer), meaning hero. It is not a directly Vedic name, but it is rooted in Sanskrit culture and carries the spirit of a valiant and prosperous individual.
